title: E-FND-0101: the full 96-conjugation symmetry sweep of the three knits on generic states, correcting the E-FND-0097...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0101 in the foundations arena: the full 96-conjugation symmetry sweep of the three knits on generic states, correcting the E-FND-0097 flag: the momentum knit is maximal (all 32 possible exact conjugations), the committed charge knit's order-eight group CONTAINS exact CP (negation with the antidiagonal mirror, a genuine parity) and exact CPT (negation, point inversion, T), resolving the flag positively (what it breaks is bare C and the axis mirrors, tying charge to orientation), while the traveller knit keeps only the identity and one PT reversal with NO negation-containing conjugation exact anywhere in the group, so CP violation is relocated to the proposed traveller sector, an invariant statement this time and a measured caution on its adoption.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
